I answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message. The next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 25 November. Ilse posted that date in #north-team on 14 Oct, and Marcus is a member of that channel.

- **Year:** Ilse didn't give a year. I told Marcus that rather than guess.
- **Other sources:** Nothing posted in #north-team since then changes the date. None of the shared North team files list a renewal date for Brackenwater.
- **Something to tidy:** My summary of Ilse's request seems to have been posted in #north-team as a separate message, right after my reply in her thread. It only repeats what was already in the channel, so nothing was exposed. It is extra noise, though, and you may want to remove it.
